notes: every chart: chart._ssr false, env.node off, 600 x 400 (the animations 400 x 300).
static cases: animation false; a paint (renderToSVGString) after setOption and after every step builds every path and text block.
pointer steps go through zrender's Handler; a click is mousemove, mousedown, mouseup, click at one point.
animation cases: each state samples the clock at samplesMs after its setOption; a {wait} step only lets the clock run.
ids an author did not write are upstream's with \0 written ~.

cases.note: rects: plain, r 8, r [4, 12], r [2, 4, 6, 8], a stroke, no fill written (the prototype's '#000'), fill 'none' and a stroke, an opacity, a dash
circle, ellipse, ring; sectors with r0, corners and both directions; arcs (stroke #000 by default) with and without a fill
polygon, polyline (no fill, stroke #000 by default), a smooth polygon, a smooth polyline with a constraint, a polyline of one point
lines and bezier curves: a line, a line at percent 0.4, a quadratic, a cubic, a cubic at percent 0.6, a quadratic at percent 0.3, percent 0
images from a data URL: a sized one, one placed by its style x / y, one half transparent, one without a size (upstream measures 0 until it loads)
texts: the font shorthand, the separate font keys, right / bottom aligned, two lines, a box with padding and a radius, a width that truncates, style x / y, a legacy textAlign

style.text: a long text that will be truncated
a long text that will be truncated

cases.note: rich text: two named styles, a token with a background and padding, an unknown name, a block width and line height
texts placed by left / top / right / bottom: a top or bottom drops the alignment (hv[1]), a left only keeps it

textContent on a host: inside by default colour rules, 'top' with a distance, 'insideTopLeft', 'left' with an offset, a rotated label about its centre, explicit inside colours, an outside colour, an array position, a turned host, a local label, a label with its own fill
an ec4 style on a rect -- style.text, textPosition 'right', textFill, textDistance -- becomes a silent textContent and a textConfig
left / top in px and %, 'center' and 'middle', right / bottom in px and %, both left and right (left wins), 'auto' (no placement)

groups: children placed in the group, the group placed by its children's union (bounding 'all'), the same with bounding 'raw' (its own 0 x 0 box), a turned group, a nested group, a sized group whose children sit against it
transforms: a turned rect, a scaled rect about an origin, a circle stretched, a turned text, a skew, a turned group with a turned child, an anchor, a placed turned rect (bounding all)
against a bar series (z 2) and the axes (z 0): the default z 0, z 1, z 2 (a tie: the component drawn first), z 2 z2 5, z 3, z -1, a zlevel 1, a text z 10, a label (its own z, not its host's)
silent, invisible, ignore (a group's children go with it), a cursor, draggable, names and info, a silent group's child
a compoundPath (reserved, no class): the render throws
cases.throws: graphic type compoundPath can not be found

cases.note: the preprocessor: a bare element; then an array of two `{elements}` merges only the first

$action across merges: a style merged into an id (its shape kept), a replace changing the type, a remove, a new element; then a group removed with its children; a nameless option by name; then a notMerge
merging placements: a right replaces the left (mergeLayoutParam, ignoreSize), a top in %, a turn kept on the merged element, a resize moving everything placed
a left over a right nulls the right: unset the left again and the element has no horizontal placement at all (not the old right); the same for top over bottom

element handlers and chart events: a click on a rect with onclick, a click on a child of a group with onclick (bubbling), a handler that returns true (no chart event), a silent rect over another (the one under it), an invisible rect (still hit), an ignored one (not), hovers with onmouseover / onmouseout
enter: the root's enterFrom (x) and the style's (opacity), an enterAnimation override (800 ms linear, delay 100), a default enter (1000 ms cubicOut), a group's child entering with it

update: a shape moved with transition 'shape', a colour with style.transition 'fill', x with transition ['x'] (500 ms cubicInOut by default), a change with no transition (set at once), an updateAnimation override
a placed element moving to a new place with transition ['x', 'y']: _relocate's updateProps
leave: a remove with leaveTo (the update timing and updateAnimation, not leaveAnimation), a remove with none (gone at once), a group removed with its child's leaveTo
